title: Original PARDUS Super Sport independent review
notes: The review covers an original-generation Super Sport and reports a 9.5 kg test bike plus a qualitative impression that the frame did not feel insufficiently stiff. Those observations are build- and rider-specific, so neither is transferred to the current photographed fluorescent 105 HDB configuration or treated as a numeric stiffness result. Its 23C test tires likewise do not establish maximum clearance.
